জনাব সালেহ আহমেদ
৩৫তম বিসিএস (সাধারণ শিক্ষা)
প্রভাষক, ইংরেজি বিভাগ।
মৌলভীবাজার সরকারি কলেজ।

English-Wizard.question: ১) They are not happy. The correct interrogative form of the sentence is -
English-Wizard.option3: গ) Don’t they happy?
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) Weren’t they happy?
English-Wizard.exp:
Assertive sentence টি যদি affirmative form এ থাকে তাহলে তাকে Interrogative এ Transform করতে হলে Negative Interrogative এ পরিণত করতে হয় এবং negative form এ থাকলে সেটাকে Affirmative interrogative এ পরিণত করতে হয়।

সে অনুসারে সঠিক উত্তর হবে খ) Are they happy?

English-Wizard.question: ২) What is the meaning of Musk?
English-Wizard.option3: গ) a substance used in making perfume
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) a disguise
English-Wizard.exp:
Musk = কস্তুরী, মৃগনাভি = a substance used in making perfume.
Mask = মুখোশ; নকল মুখ; ছদ্মবেশ = a face cover.

Source: Accessible Dictionary

English-Wizard.question: ৩) They should follow my advice. (make it imperative)
English-Wizard.option1: ক) Let them to follow my advice.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) Let they follow my advice.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) Let them follow my advice.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) They have to follow my advice.
English-Wizard.exp:
You ছাড়া অন্য Subject থাকলে Imperative Sentence এর শুরুতে Let ব্যবহৃত হয় এবং Subject এর Objective Form বসে। 

সে অনুসারে সঠিক উত্তর হবে - গ) Let them follow my advice.

English-Wizard.question: ৪) 'You look terrific in that dress!' The word 'terrific' in the above sentence means -
English-Wizard.option3: গ) very ugly
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) horrible
English-Wizard.exp:
Terrific (informal): excellent, wonderful
Example sentence:
I feel absolutely terrific today!
She's doing a terrific job.
You look terrific in that dress.

Source: Oxford Dictionary

English-Wizard.question: ৫) The client requested me to clarify the matter. (Make it direct)
English-Wizard.option1: ক) The client said to me, “You will clarify the matter”.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) The client said to me, “Please, clarify the matter”.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) The client said to me, “You clarify the matter”.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) The client said to me, “Why don’t you clarify the matter?”
English-Wizard.exp:
Indirect Narration এ request থাকলে Direct করার সময় please যোগ হতে পারে এবং বাক্যটা Imperative হবে।

সে অনুসারে সঠিক উত্তর: খ) The client said to me, “Please, clarify the matter”.

English-Wizard.question: ৬) Beret is a kind of -
English-Wizard.option3: গ) Bag
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) Bread
English-Wizard.exp:
Beret 
- a round, flat hat made of soft material.
- গরম বা সুতি কাপড়ের চ্যাপটা টুপিবিশেষ (খেলাধুলা বা ভ্রমণের সময় ব্যবহৃত হয়, সামরিক বাহিনীর সদস্যরাও পরিধান করে)।

Source: Cambridge Dictionary and Accessible Dictionary

English-Wizard.question: ৭) He said to me, “Will you obey my order now?” (Make it indirect)
English-Wizard.option1: ক) He said to me that I would obey his order now.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) He asked me that I would obey his order now.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) He inquired of me if I would obey his order then.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) He asked me that I would obey his order then.
English-Wizard.exp:
- Interrogative Sentence হওয়ায় Reporting Verb - Say এর পরিবর্তে inquire (of + object) (জানতে চওয়া)/ ask (জিজ্ঞাসা করা) ব্যবহার করতে হবে। 
- Yes/No Question হওয়ায় Reported speech শুরু করার পূর্বে If/whether (কি না) ব্যবহার করতে হবে।  
- বক্তা ও শ্রোতা অনুযায়ী Reported Speech এর Subject ও Object পরিবর্তন করতে হবে। (you => I, my => his)
- Reporting Verb (say) Past Tense হওয়ায় Reported Speech (Inverted Comma এর ভেতরের অংশ) নিয়ম অনুযায়ী Past Form এ রূপান্তর করতে হবে। (will => would)
- Reporting Verb, Past Tense হওয়ায় Reported Speech এ নিকটবর্তী নির্দেশনাসূচক শব্দকে দূরবর্তী নির্দেশনাসূচক শব্দে পরিণত করতে হবে। (now => then)
- Sentence কে Assertive Sentence বানাতে হবে। অর্থাৎ এখানে Auxiliary Verb – would- Subject এর পরে বসবে। 

সে অনুসারে সঠিক উত্তর: গ) He inquired of me if I would obey his order then.

English-Wizard.question: ৮) The appropriate Assertive Form of the sentence “Read the book” is -
English-Wizard.option2: খ) You should read the book.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) You must read the book.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) You required to read the book.
English-Wizard.exp:
Imperative Sentence কে Appropriately Assertive করতে হলে Subject এর পর should বসে। এর পর মূল Verb এর Base Form বসে।
এ হিসেবে সঠিক উত্তর (খ)। 

(ঘ) শুদ্ধ হতো যদি প্রথম অংশ Passive (You are required) থাকতো।

English-Wizard.question: ৯) Docile is -
English-Wizard.option2: খ) to serve as a reminder of.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) easily handled or manageable.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) not possible or unable to be done.
English-Wizard.exp:
Docile
Quiet and easy to influence, persuade, or control.
সহজে বশ মানে এমন; বাধ্য; সহজে শেখানো যায় এমন।

Source: Cambridge Dictionary and Accessible Dictionary

English-Wizard.question: ১০) How interesting the story was! (Make it assertive)
English-Wizard.option1: ক) The story was enough interesting.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) It was a very interesting story.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) It was an interesting story.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) The story was very interesting.
English-Wizard.exp:
এখানে Subject হচ্ছে the story.
How এর পরিবর্তে Assertive Sentence এ সাধারণত very ব্যবহৃত হয়। 
Enough বসালে বাক্যের ভাবার্থ ঠিক থাকবে না। তাছাড়া Adjective এর আগে enough বসে না, পরে বসে। Noun এর আগে enough বসতে পারে।

English-Wizard.question: ১১) The word 'florid' indicates –
English-Wizard.option3: গ) floor
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) flower
English-Wizard.exp:
Florid
- Covered with flowers; abounding in flowers; flowery.
- অত্যধিক অলংকৃত; অলংকারবহুল; পুষ্পল; জমকালো; বর্ণাঢ্য

Source: Accessible Dictionary.

English-Wizard.question: ১২) He asked me if I had ever heard the name of Hatim Tai. (Make it direct)
English-Wizard.option1: ক) He said to me, “If you have ever heard the name of Hatim Tai?”
English-Wizard.option2: খ) He said to me, “Did you ever hear the name of Hatim Tai?”
English-Wizard.option3: গ) He said to me, “Have you ever heard the name of Hatim Tai?”
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) He said to me, “Do you ever hear the name of Hatim Tai?”
English-Wizard.exp:
Indirect Narration এ Past Perfect থাকলে তিনটি Tense হওয়ার সম্ভাবনা আছে। যথা- 
- Present Perfect 
- Past Indefinite 
- Past Perfect

যেহেতু এখানে ever (কখনো) উল্লেখ করা আছে, তাই এটা Present Perfect Tense হওয়াই বাঞ্ছনীয়।
তাই সঠিক উত্তর (গ)।

English-Wizard.question: ১৩) Gauche means -
English-Wizard.option3: গ) the leaves of a plant.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) a class of artistic endeavor having a particular form.
English-Wizard.exp:
Gauche: 
- behaving in a way that is offensive to other people, esp. because of not knowing what is correct or not caring about the feelings of others:
- সামাজিকভাবে অপ্রতিভ; আড়ষ্ট; কৌশলহীন; কাণ্ডজ্ঞানহীন; বেআক্কেল; পরিবেশ-পরিস্থিতি ও লোক না-বুঝে কথা বলা।

Source: Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

English-Wizard.question: ১৪) Celerity is -
English-Wizard.option3: গ) Swiftness
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) Disaster
English-Wizard.exp:
Celerity
- Rapidity of motion; quickness; swiftness.
- দ্রুততা; তৎপরতা।

Source: Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy

English-Wizard.question: ১৫) John said to me over telephone, “When are you arriving here?” (Make it indirect)
English-Wizard.option1: ক) John asked me over telephone when I was arriving here.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) John asked me over telephone when was I arriving there.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) John asked me over telephone when I was arriving there.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) John said to me over telephone when I was going there.
English-Wizard.exp:
Interrogative sentence এর ক্ষেত্রে indirect করার সময় 
- said এর পরিবর্তে Asked বসবে। 
- auxiliary – subject এর পরে বসবে। 
- here এর পরিবর্তে there হয়।

সে অনুসারে সঠিক উত্তর: গ) John asked me over telephone when I was arriving there.

English-Wizard.question: ১৬) Inferior means -
English-Wizard.option3: গ) Lower in degree.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) Competing with others
English-Wizard.exp:
Inferior:
Lower in place, rank, excellence, etc.
নিকৃষ্ট; অধস্তন; ন্যূন; হীন।

English-Wizard.question: ১৭) Everybody accepted it. (Make it Interrogative)
English-Wizard.option1: ক) Who did not accepted it?
English-Wizard.option3: গ) Did everybody accept it?
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) Who did not accept it?
English-Wizard.exp:
Everybody থাকলে interrogative করতে হলে Who + do/did not বসে। 
বাক্যটি Past Indefinite Tense হওয়ায় Did not যোগ হবে এবং এর পরে verb এর base form বসবে।

English-Wizard.question: ১৮) Misogynist is a person who hates -
English-Wizard.option3: গ) women
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) to get marry
English-Wizard.exp:
Misogynist 
- a man who hates women or believes that men are much better than women.
- নারীবিদ্বেষী।

Source: Cambridge Dictionary and Accessible Dictionary

English-Wizard.question: ১৯) Carnivorous means -
English-Wizard.option3: গ) Grass-eating
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) Blood-drinking
English-Wizard.exp:
Carnivorous 
- an animal that eats meat.
- মাংসাশী

Source: Cambridge Dictionary and Accessible Dictionary

English-Wizard.question: ২০) Choose the best indirect form of the sentence: He said, “Kamal, come here”.
English-Wizard.option1: ক) He requested Kamal to come here.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) He asked Kamal to come here.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) He said Kamal to go there.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) He told Kamal to go there.
English-Wizard.exp:
Vocative Case হিসেবে কোনো Proper Noun থাকলে এটাকে Reporting Verb এর Object বানিয়ে দেয়া যায়। 
আর Imperative Sentence কোনো Specific Mood প্রকাশ না করলে Reporting Verb হিসেবে Tell ব্যবহার করা যায়।
Reporting Verb - Past Tense থাকলে নিকটবর্তী নির্দেশনাসূচক শব্দ দূরবর্তী নির্দেশনাসূচক শব্দে পরিণত হয়।
তাই এখানে Come = go এবং here = there হবে। 

তাই সঠিক উত্তর (ঘ)।
